title: 第一章 陆诚风雪山神庙第二章 拳怕少壮钱壮怂人胆
slug: 民国戏子请叫我武道宗师
content_zh:
北平，天桥。
冬至刚过，风吹在脸上生疼。
德云茶园的后台，此刻乱成了一锅粥。
“跑了，你说小盛云跑了？！”
班主周大奎手里那把紫砂壶，“啪”地一声摔了个粉碎。
报信的小徒弟吓得跪在地上，带着哭腔。
“师父，刚去催妆，屋里没人，包袱也没了，就留了张字条……说是隔壁‘庆和班’给了一百块现大洋的安家费，他、他去那边唱角儿了。”
一百块现大洋！
这年头，一块大洋能在东四牌楼吃顿好的涮羊肉，一百块，那是买命钱。
足以让一个戏子背信弃义。
周大奎身子一晃，差点没昏死过去。
这几年世道乱，军阀像走马灯似的换。
今儿个秦系，明儿个燕系，老百姓兜里比脸还干净。
今儿这场戏，是周大奎磕了多少响头，才请来了城南一霸……金爷。
为的什么？
就为了让金爷捧个场，赏口饭吃，保住这个班子！
前场戏唱得稀烂，茶客们已经开始摔茶碗、骂闲街了。
这压轴的《林冲夜奔》要是再开天窗，不用金爷动手，光是底下的茶客就能把这戏台子给拆了。
“完了，庆云班完了……”
周大奎瘫在太师椅上，面如死灰。

后台众人，一个个垂头丧气。
班子散了，那就是失业。
角落里。
陆诚紧了紧腰间的练功带。
他穿越过来三天了。
这三天，他看清了这个吃人的世道。
前身也叫陆诚，是个苦出身，练的是武生。
夏练三伏，冬练三九，一身童子功练了整整十二年，没破过身，没偷过懒。
可惜，祖师爷不赏饭。
这具身体，太“正”了。
练武是把好手，可一上台，身段发僵，眼神发木，唱戏讲究个“韵味”，他没有。
所以混到现在，也就是个跑龙套的武行，偶尔替补一下。
陆诚家原不算窘迫，偏老娘近年咳血缠绵，一贴药就要两百铜子。
五十多岁的老爹，如今只得像头老牛，在风口里拉洋车谋活。
如果庆云班散了，他就没钱拿回家。
断了钱，就是断了药。
断了药，他娘就得死。
不能散！
陆诚深吸一口气，站了起来。
“班主，我来唱。”

话音刚落，乱糟糟的后台猛地一静。
content_en:
Peking, flyover.
Just after the winter solstice, the wind hurts my face.
The backstage of Deyun Tea Garden was now a mess.
"Run away, you said Xiao Shengyun ran away?!"
The purple clay pot in class leader Zhou Dakui's hand smashed into pieces with a "pop" sound.
The little apprentice who reported the news was so frightened that he knelt on the ground and cried.
"Master, I just went to make up, but there was no one in the house and my luggage was gone, so I left a note... saying that the 'Qinghe Class' next door gave me a hundred yuan as a settlement allowance, and he, he went to sing a role there."
One hundred yuan is now in the ocean!
These days, a big ocean can buy you a good mutton-shabu meal at Dongsi Archway. A hundred yuan is money to buy your life.
It's enough to make an actor treacherous.
Zhou Dakui swayed and almost fainted.
In recent years, the world has been in chaos, with warlords changing like a revolving door.
Today it is the Qin family, and tomorrow it is the Yan family. The people's pockets are cleaner than their faces.
In today's scene, Zhou Dakui kowtowed many times before inviting the tyrant in the south of the city... Lord Jin.
Why?
Just to make Mr. Jin look good, enjoy the meal, and keep this team!
The prelude was very poorly sung, and the tea patrons had already begun throwing tea bowls and cursing.
If the finale of "Lin Chong's Night Run" were to open the skylight again, the teagoers below would be able to tear down the stage without Mr. Jin having to do anything.
"It's over, Qingyun class is over..."
Zhou Dakui collapsed on the Taishi chair, his face ashen.
Everyone in the background was dejected.
If the team is disbanded, that means unemployment.
corner.
Lu Cheng tightened the exercise belt around his waist.
It has been three days since he traveled through time.
In these three days, he saw clearly the world of cannibalism.
My predecessor was also called Lu Cheng. He came from a poor background and trained as a martial arts student.
I practiced Sanfu in the summer and Sanjiu in the winter. I practiced the boy's skill for twelve years without ever losing my virginity or being lazy.
It's a pity that the ancestor didn't reward me with food.
This body is so "right".
He is a good martial artist, but as soon as he goes on stage, his body becomes stiff and his eyes become dull. He doesn't have "charm" when it comes to singing.
So until now, I am just a sidekick in martial arts, occasionally filling in as a substitute.
Lu Cheng's family was not in distress at first, but my mother had been coughing up blood in recent years, and a patch of medicine cost two hundred coppers.
The father, who is in his fifties, now has no choice but to make a living by pulling a foreign truck in the wind.
If Qingyun's class breaks up, he won't have any money to take home.
If you cut off the money, you will cut off the medicine.
If he stops taking the medicine, his mother will die.
Can't break up!
Lu Cheng took a deep breath and stood up.
"Master, I'll sing."
As soon as he finished speaking, the messy backstage suddenly fell silent.
